response.text:
Diagnosis:
- All synthetic HTTPS checks to api.example.com are failing.
- Logs show the TLS certificate for api.example.com expired, and cert-manager is unable to renew it due to a DNS-01 challenge failure (API token revoked).
- Restarting cert-manager did not resolve the issue; the renewal continues to fail due to the revoked API token.

Remediation:
- I paged the on-call engineer, as human intervention is required to resolve the DNS-01 challenge and update the API token.
- I posted a public status update informing customers of the outage and ongoing investigation.

Next steps require updating the DNS-01 challenge credentials or API token to restore certificate renewal.
